description: Unit tests for the CohortService class in the OpenMRS API module, testing various cohort management functionalities including creation, retrieval, updating, voiding, and membership management.

classes.name: CohortServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class testing the functionalities of the CohortService in the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: runBeforeAllTests
methods.description: Initializes the CohortService before each test.

methods.name: getCohort_shouldOnlyGetNonVoidedCohortsByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of non-voided cohorts by name.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid_shouldFindObjectGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving a cohort by a valid UUID.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving a cohort with an invalid UUID returns null.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid_shouldFindObjectGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving a cohort membership by valid UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieving a cohort membership with invalid UUID returns null.

methods.name: purgeCohort_shouldDeleteCohortFromDatabase
methods.description: Tests deletion of a cohort.

methods.name: getCohorts_shouldMatchCohortsByPartialName
methods.description: Tests cohort retrieval based on partial name matching.

methods.name: getCohorts_shouldBeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Verifies case-insensitive search for cohorts.

methods.name: getCohorts_shouldReturnCohortsInAscendingOrder
methods.description: Checks that cohorts are returned sorted by name.

methods.name: saveCohort_shouldCreateNewCohorts
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new cohort.

methods.name: saveCohort_shouldUpdateAnExistingCohort
methods.description: Tests updating an existing cohort.

methods.name: voidCohort_shouldFailIfReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that voiding a cohort with an empty reason throws an exception.

methods.name: voidCohort_shouldFailIfReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that voiding a cohort with null reason throws an exception.

methods.name: voidCohort_shouldNotChangeAnAlreadyVoidedCohort
methods.description: Verifies that voiding an already voided cohort retains original void reason.

methods.name: voidCohort_shouldVoidCohort
methods.description: Tests voiding a cohort.

methods.name: getCohort_shouldGetCohortById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a cohort by ID.

methods.name: getCohort_shouldGetCohortGivenAName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a cohort by name.

methods.name: getCohort_shouldGetTheNonvoidedCohortIfTwoExistWithSameName
methods.description: Ensures that getCohort by name returns the non-voided cohort when duplicates exist.

methods.name: getAllCohorts_shouldGetAllNonvoidedCohortsInDatabase
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all non-voided cohorts.

methods.name: getAllCohorts_shouldReturnCohortsInAscendingOrderByName
methods.description: Checks the order of cohorts returned by getAllCohorts.

methods.name: getAllCohorts_shouldNotReturnAnyVoidedCohorts
methods.description: Verifies that getAllCohorts without parameters excludes voided cohorts.

methods.name: getAllCohorts_shouldReturnAllCohortsAndVoided
methods.description: Checks that getAllCohorts(true) includes voided cohorts.

methods.name: getCohorts_shouldNeverReturnNull
methods.description: Ensures getCohorts always returns a non-null list.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient_shouldNotReturnVoidedCohorts
methods.description: Verifies that cohorts with voided status are excluded when fetching cohorts containing a patient.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient_shouldReturnCohortsThatHaveGivenPatient
methods.description: Tests retrieving cohorts containing a specific patient.

methods.name: addPatientToCohort_shouldAddAPatientAndSaveTheCohort
methods.description: Tests adding a patient to a cohort and saving it.

methods.name: addPatientToCohort_shouldNotFailIfCohortAlreadyContainsPatient
methods.description: Verifies adding the same patient multiple times does not cause failure.

methods.name: removePatientFromCohort_shouldNotFailIfCohortDoesNotContainPatient
methods.description: Ensures removing a non-member patient does not fail.

methods.name: removePatientFromCohort_shouldSaveCohortAfterRemovingPatient
methods.description: Verifies cohort is saved after removing a patient.

methods.name: purgeCohortMembership_shouldRemoveMembershipFromCohort
methods.description: Tests removing a cohrt membership from a cohort.

methods.name: voidCohortMembership_shouldVoidCohortMembership
methods.description: Tests voiding a cohort membership.

methods.name: getCohort_shouldGetCohortByName
methods.description: Retrieves cohort by name.

methods.name: endCohortMembership_shouldEndTheCohortMembership
methods.description: Ends a cohort membership by setting its end date.

methods.name: patientVoided_shouldVoidMemberships
methods.description: Verifies that cohort memberships are voided when a patient is voided.

methods.name: patientUnvoided_shouldUnvoidMemberships
methods.description: Verify that cohort memberships are unvoided when a patient is unvoided.

methods.name: getMemberships_shouldGetMembershipsAsOfADate
methods.description: Checks retrieving active memberships as of a specific date.

methods.name: getMemberships_shouldNotGetMatchingMembershipsAsOfADate

methods.description: Checks that voided memberships are returned when requested.

methods.name: getMemberships_shouldReturnUnvoidedMemberships
methods.description: Verifies that only unvoided memberships are returned.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient_shouldNotReturnEndedMemberships
methods.description: Ensures that ended memberships are excluded.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships_shouldGetMembershipsContainingPatient
methods.description: Tests retrieval of cohort memberships for a patient.

methods.description: Tests inclusion of voided memberships based on flag.
